digest.component_or_area: CLI argument parsing and command registration (src/rebar/_cli/)
propositions: Advanced command grammars (bridge, reconcile, audit, workflow, identity, gate, and verification commands) currently mix inline argparse construction with manual dispatch and lack reusable factory contract
Current inline construction and inconsistent --help behavior contribute to 21 unsafe/incomplete top-level help forms
Migrated parsers must be constructed in lean modules without importing optional runtimes (Pydantic AI, FastAPI, Jira transport, workflow executor, tracing)

Parser factories must raise ParseError instead of SystemExit(2) for consistent error handling; handlers currently catching SystemExit must be updated to catch ParseError and reproduce identical exit codes and stderr/usage bytes
All migrated commands carrying custom usage, RawDescriptionHelpFormatter, or add_help=False must preserve byte-identical --help output through optional keyword passthroughs to the S2a factory
Every registered advanced route must have a valid parser-factory reference and be deterministically generation-ready without executing handlers or loading optional runtime modules
